operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Denied access redirects to account settings; query failure does not establish an age group. Age normalization/provider remains imported.

operationContracts.name: 发起年龄验证或刷新验证状态
operationContracts.effect: Get a settings-scoped verification controller; require matching account/user/auth/eligibility/current-account identity before start. Reuse controller and watch identity/eligibility changes to dispose/reset. UI retry uses phase retry when present, otherwise start.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: loading/active/refreshing disable action. pending/redirect/refresh-error offer authoritative readback rather than assuming success or submitting another inquiry. Provider controller and authoritative readback remain delegated.

operationContracts.name: 浏览和搜索已保存密码的元数据
operationContracts.effect: Wait for account/user identity, fetch cursor pages with expectedIdentity and account header, search loaded origin/account_label and show metadata details. Schema contains credential_id/origin/account_label/created_at, not plaintext password; count is total only after all pages.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: No query retry/cache retention; load errors, empty data and no loaded match differ. More pages require load-more before search can cover the rest. Metadata surfaces carry privacy masking.

operationContracts.name: 确认删除已保存的网站密码
operationContracts.effect: Confirm the selected credential identity, block duplicate pending deletion, issue account/user-bound delete without retry and require deleted response validation. Success clears selection and refetches list.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Uncertain delete/list results show reconciliation error and refresh; refresh does not retry deletion. Deleting stored credentials does not sign out an existing website session.

operationContracts.name: 查看并刷新 1Password 连接状态
operationContracts.effect: Under feature flag, key status by user/account; suppress query/actions when callback workspace differs. connecting polls every1500ms except unconfirmed callback. Clean callback parameters only after confirmed connected readback or successful disconnect.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Unavailable, unknown, connecting, failed/reconnect_required and unconfirmed callback differ. Error means unconfirmed operation; closing authorization browser is not connection success.

operationContracts.name: 连接或重新连接 1Password
operationContracts.effect: After identity/availability checks, request enrollment with expected_account_user_id and never retry. Accept only three exact HTTPS origins with /oauth/authorize. Use provided tab or external browser; tab path clears sessionStorage and adds no-referrer metadata before replacement.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Null/closed tab, missing identity or invalid destination rejects and closes the provided tab. Enrollment URL/navigation is not a persisted connection; refetch authoritative status on settled.

operationContracts.name: 断开 1Password 连接
operationContracts.effect: Confirm disconnect and send identity/account-bound delete with retry never; refetch connection status on settled and clean callback query only after confirmed outcome.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Network/response error remains unconfirmed and requires refresh. Disconnecting provider access does not imply deletion of all saved-password records or website logout.

operationContracts.effect: Fetch config per account-user identity and serialize mutations per query scope. Map always_ask to always_ask/disable_auto_review:true, auto_approve to always_ask/false, always_allow to never_ask/true. Update cache from successful response.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Disable controls until data available or while mutation pending; loading/unavailable labels differ. OnePassword callback query redirects to passwords while preserving spread location fields; no separate Navigate state prop is supplied.

operationContracts.name: 查看 Work 或 dot 保存的网站 Cookie 元数据
operationContracts.effect: Work reads flora cookies by account-user key. dot uses Orbit surface plus account/user expectedIdentity and current-account checks before/after fetch, requires a target, and recognizes target-unavailable404 separately. Group host/count metadata by site with host expansion.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Account mismatch/abort or absent target cannot present stale data as current. No dot found is different from query error or zero cookies. Imported grouping/domain rules and actual target acquisition remain delegated.

operationContracts.name: 确认清除网站或全部云电脑 Cookie
operationContracts.effect: Choose exact host, site including subdomains or all; confirm before mutation. Work deletes by host or agent/browser_context then filters/invalidate cache. dot first cancels queries and checks account/target, sending Orbit surface and captured target with nonretry policy.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Changed identity or unavailable target aborts dot deletion. Failure keeps confirmation/error; success closes. Host-only deletion preserves child/sibling hosts; all clears the selected context, not arbitrary other targets.

moduleDecisions.decision: Separate age presentation from settings-scoped verification lifecycle and provider/authoritative-readback adapters; preserve phase distinction and identity disposal.

Separate masked saved-credential metadata/delete reconciliation from 1Password enrollment/status/revocation. Preserve expectedIdentity and nonretry mutations; do not add plaintext password storage or reveal.
Separate config/site permission policy, cookie views and passkey metadata from adapters; retain distinct Work and Orbit target/identity rules rather than merging endpoints.
